name: Bali
description: Tropical paradise with stunning beaches, lush rice terraces, vibrant culture and spiritual temples.

name: Paris
description: The City of Light – romantic streets, world-class museums, iconic Eiffel Tower and exquisite cuisine.

name: Tokyo
description: Futuristic metropolis blending ancient temples with neon skyscrapers, incredible food and unique experiences.

name: Santorini
description: Famous for its white-washed buildings, blue domes, dramatic cliffs and breathtaking sunsets over the Aegean Sea.

name: Cape Town
description: Stunning coastal city with Table Mountain, vibrant culture, excellent wine and diverse outdoor adventures.

name: New York City
description: The city that never sleeps – iconic skyline, Broadway shows, world-class museums and endless energy.

name: Machu Picchu
description: Ancient Incan citadel high in the Andes – one of the most spectacular archaeological sites in the world.

name: Dubai
description: Ultra-modern desert city with luxury shopping, record-breaking architecture and desert adventures.

name: Reykjavik
description: Gateway to glaciers, volcanoes, northern lights and the famous Blue Lagoon geothermal spa.

name: Bangkok
description: Vibrant capital with ornate temples, floating markets, street food paradise and lively nightlife.

name: Barcelona
description: Gaudi masterpieces, sunny beaches, fantastic food and a perfect mix of culture and Mediterranean vibe.

name: Queenstown
description: Adventure capital of the world – bungee jumping, skiing, hiking and breathtaking alpine scenery.
